# fleet API

Mowers, sites, groups, linked cloud accounts, base stations and commands.

Base path `/api/v1/fleet` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/fleet.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/fleet.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

### base-stations

#### GET /api/v1/fleet/base-stations

**List Base Stations**

The RTK base stations of the caller's account with their linked mowers (`can_view`).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [BaseStationList](#basestationlist) |
| 403 | The caller lacks the relation on the account. | no body |
| 404 | No such base station in the caller's account. | no body |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/base-stations

**Register Base Station**

Register an RTK base station (`can_manage_mowers`): a device of a linked account that its device list marks `rtk_base`, or (`source` `simulated`) the simulator's base station. 409 `base-station-already-registered` when that physical base station is registered already (in this or another account, which is not named).

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [BaseStationIn](#basestationin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | Successful Response | `application/json` [BaseStationOut](#basestationout) |
| 403 | The caller lacks the relation on the account. | no body |
| 404 | No such base station in the caller's account. | no body |
| 409 | `base-station-already-registered`, or the account's limit. | no body |
| 422 | Unknown linked account or device, or not an RTK base station. | no body |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/base-stations/{base_station_id}/firmware/check

**Check Base Station Firmware**

Ask the vendor for the base station's firmware through a linked mower (`can_view`); the answer also lands in the linked mowers' state (`MowerState.base_station`).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base_station_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [FirmwareInfo](#firmwareinfo) |
| 403 | The caller lacks the relation on the account. | no body |
| 404 | No such base station in the caller's account. | no body |
| 409 | `base-station-not-linked`: no mower is linked to it. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |
| 503 | No Device-Gateway holding a linked mower answered. | no body |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/base-stations/{base_station_id}/firmware/update

**Update Base Station Firmware**

Install the offered firmware (`can_manage_mowers` and the plan feature `control`): the command `base_station_firmware_update` goes to a linked mower, which relays it to the vendor; follow it at `status_url`. The mower refuses it while it mows, returns, updates or drives, or when the version is not the offered one.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base_station_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [BaseStationFirmwareUpdateIn](#basestationfirmwareupdatein)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 202 | Successful Response | `application/json` [CommandAccepted](#commandaccepted) |
| 403 | The caller lacks the relation on the account. | no body |
| 404 | No such base station in the caller's account. | no body |
| 409 | `base-station-not-linked`: no mower is linked to it. | no body |
| 422 | `mower_id` is not linked to the base station. | no body |

#### PUT /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/base-station

**Set Mower Base Station**

Link the mower to an RTK base station of the account, or unlink it with `null` (`can_manage_mowers` on the mower). A cloud base station serves cloud mowers of its own linked account, the simulated one simulated mowers. Publishes `mower.updated`: the Device-Gateway reconnects the mower with the base station.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [MowerBaseStationIn](#mowerbasestationin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowerOut](#mowerout) |
| 403 | The caller sees the mower but has no `can_manage_mowers`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower or the base station does not exist in the account. | no body |
| 409 | `base-station-not-applicable`: it cannot serve this mower. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### linked-accounts

#### GET /api/v1/fleet/linked-accounts

**List Linked Accounts**

The linked vendor accounts of the caller's account (no secrets).

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [LinkedAccountList](#linkedaccountlist) |
| 403 | The caller lacks `can_manage_mowers` on the account. | no body |
| 404 | No such linked account in the caller's account. | no body |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/linked-accounts

**Create Linked Account**

Link a vendor account: Fleet checks the credentials against the provider's fields (422 with one problem per field, `credentials/<key>`), asks the Device-Gateway to log in and list the devices (`gateway.cloud.discover`) and stores the account with its secret fields encrypted. An unknown or disabled provider is 422 (field `provider`).

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [LinkedAccountIn](#linkedaccountin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | Successful Response | `application/json` [LinkedAccountDetail](#linkedaccountdetail) |
| 403 | The caller lacks `can_manage_mowers` on the account. | no body |
| 404 | No such linked account in the caller's account. | no body |
| 409 | Linked. | no body |
| 422 | `linked-account-login-failed`: the cloud refused the credentials. | no body |
| 429 | Too many failed logins for this vendor account (`Retry-After`). | no body |
| 503 | No credential encryption key, or no Device-Gateway or vendor cloud answered. | no body |

#### GET /api/v1/fleet/linked-accounts/providers

**List Cloud Providers**

The cloud providers enabled in the Device-Gateway: id, name, the credential fields of the link form (with hints and links to where the vendor hands them out), whether the user needs a developer account at the vendor and whether the adapter was tested on real hardware. Disabled providers are not listed; the public demo (ADR 0068) lists none and refuses every change under this path. Texts come in the language of `locale` (or the first of `Accept-Language`), else English.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locale` | query | string or null | no | Language of the texts (`de`, `en`; `de-DE` works too). Default: the first language of `Accept-Language`, else `en`; a language without texts falls back to `en`. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ProviderList](#providerlist) |
| 403 | The caller lacks `can_manage_mowers` on the account. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |
| 503 | No Device-Gateway listed the providers. | no body |

**Delete Linked Account**

Remove the link. Refused (409, the mowers in `errors`) while mowers use it. Step-up (ADR 0057): 401 `reauth-required` without a recent confirmation, 403 for API tokens.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `linked_account_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |
| 403 | The caller lacks `can_manage_mowers` on the account. | no body |
| 404 | No such linked account in the caller's account. | no body |
| 409 | `linked-account-in-use`: mowers still connect through it. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/linked-accounts/{linked_account_id}/mowers

**Register Linked Mowers**

Register several mowers of the linked account at once. Each one is an ordinary registration (target site and groups checked, tuples, `mower.registered`); devices that fail are listed in `failed` with the problem they would have answered. When none could be added the first problem is the answer.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `linked_account_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [LinkedMowersIn](#linkedmowersin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | Successful Response | `application/json` [LinkedMowersOut](#linkedmowersout) |
| 403 | The caller lacks `can_manage_mowers` on the account. | no body |
| 404 | No such linked account in the caller's account. | no body |
| 409 | `mower-already-registered` (when no device could be added). | no body |
| 422 | Unknown device, not a mower, or a device given twice. | no body |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/linked-accounts/{linked_account_id}/sync

**Sync Linked Account**

Read the device list again ("Konto neu einlesen"), optionally with new secret fields (a re-authentication). The gateway answers from the session the account's connected mowers share when there is one (a second login would log them out). A failure is kept in `last_sync_error`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `linked_account_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [LinkedAccountSyncIn](#linkedaccountsyncin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [LinkedAccountDetail](#linkedaccountdetail) |
| 403 | The caller lacks `can_manage_mowers` on the account. | no body |
| 404 | No such linked account in the caller's account. | no body |
| 422 | `linked-account-login-failed`: the cloud refused the credentials. | no body |
| 429 | Too many failed logins for this vendor account (`Retry-After`). | no body |
| 503 | No credential encryption key, or no Device-Gateway or vendor cloud answered. | no body |

#### GET /api/v1/fleet/connection-kinds

**List Connection Kinds**

The connection kinds this installation accepts (`MOWDECK_ALLOWED_CONNECTION_KINDS`) with the option schema of each: required, optional, secret and alternative options. The web app generates its connection forms from it, so a new adapter kind needs no UI change. For cloud mowers the options of each enabled provider come from its descriptor (`provider_options`, ADR 0066, their texts in the language of `locale` or `Accept-Language`); without an answering gateway that map is empty.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locale` | query | string or null | no | Language of the texts (`de`, `en`; `de-DE` works too). Default: the first language of `Accept-Language`, else `en`; a language without texts falls back to `en`. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ConnectionKindList](#connectionkindlist) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### PUT /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/area-names/{area_id}

**Set Area Name**

Name one map area in MowDeck (`can_control`; 403 when the mower is visible, else 404). `null` or a blank name drops the custom name. The mower keeps its own names: nothing is sent to the mower. Publishes `fleet.mower.area_names_changed` after a change; answers all custom names of the mower.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `area_id` | path | string | yes | `MowerMap.areas[].id`; min length 1; max length 128 |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [AreaNameIn](#areanamein)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [AreaNamesOut](#areanamesout) |
| 403 | The caller sees the mower but has no `can_control`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower does not exist or is not visible to the caller. | no body |
| 422 | The name has more than 60 characters after trimming. | no body |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/camera/session

**Open Camera Session**

A short-lived live camera session: `can_view` on the mower (hidden otherwise) and the plan feature `camera`; audited as `mower.camera_opened` with the transport used.

`transport` (ADR 0045, default `auto`): `relay` opens a lease on MowDeck's camera relay and answers its session (`provider` `relay`: WHEP URLs per camera, a ticket, `lease_id`; renew it every `heartbeat_seconds`, delete it when the page goes away). `direct` asks the Device-Gateway for the vendor session (ADR 0032; `provider` `agora`: the browser joins with the Agora Web SDK, `fake`: a test pattern). `auto` uses the relay and falls back to `direct` only when the relay cannot serve the mower's camera provider or is not deployed. The token or ticket is a secret: the response is never cached; ask again before `expires_at`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body**: `application/json` [CameraSessionIn](#camerasessionin) or null

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [CameraSession](#camerasession) |
| 403 | The plan does not include the feature `camera`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower does not exist or is not visible to the caller. | no body |
| 409 | `camera-unsupported`: the mower's connection has no camera; `camera-relay-unsupported`: `transport` `relay`, but the relay has no source for the mower's camera provider; `camera-budget`: a camera limit refused the stream. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |
| 503 | The Device-Gateway, the vendor cloud or (`transport` `relay`) the camera relay did not answer, or the mower is offline. | no body |

#### DELETE /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/camera/session/{lease_id}

**Close Camera Session**

End a relay camera lease (ADR 0045): the page was left or hidden. Idempotent: an unknown or already closed lease, or no relay at all, is 204 as well. `can_view` on the mower; only the user who opened the lease ends it (another user's lease is 404 and keeps running); no plan check (ending a stream is always allowed).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `lease_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |
| 404 | The mower is not visible, or the lease is another account's or was opened by another user. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |
| 503 | The camera relay did not answer in time. | no body |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/camera/session/{lease_id}/renew

**Renew Camera Session**

The heartbeat of a relay camera lease (ADR 0045): extends it and answers the same session with a fresh ticket (for reconnects). `can_view` on the mower and the plan feature `camera`; only the user who opened the lease renews it; never cached.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `lease_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [CameraSession](#camerasession) |
| 403 | The plan does not include the feature `camera`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower is not visible, or the lease is unknown, expired, detached, of another account or opened by another user. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |
| 503 | The camera relay is not deployed or did not answer. | no body |

#### GET /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/camera/snapshot

**Camera Snapshot**

A still image of the mower's camera for API clients (`can_view` on the mower, hidden otherwise, and the plan feature `camera`): taken by the Device-Gateway with the mower's own photo function or through the camera relay, keeping every camera limit (a sleeping mower is not woken). At most one new image per mower every `MOWDECK_CAMERA_SNAPSHOT_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS` (30 s); requests in between get the last one. A new image is audited as `mower.camera_snapshot`; Fleet never stores it.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | The image, with `X-Snapshot-Taken-At` (ISO 8601). | `image/jpeg` any, `image/png` any |
| 403 | The plan does not include the feature `camera`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower does not exist or is not visible to the caller. | no body |
| 409 | `camera-unsupported`: the mower's connection cannot take a photo. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |
| 503 | No Device-Gateway holds the mower or none answered in time, the mower is offline or asleep, or a camera limit (battery, budget) refused the image. | no body |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/commands

**Send Command**

Send a command. The relation depends on the kind: `can_control` (start, pause, resume, dock, blade height, speed), `can_drive` (manual drive, spot mow, drive calibration, drive speed setting), `can_emergency_stop` (emergency stop, equals `can_view`). Checked before any database or bus access: 403 when the mower is visible, 404 when not.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [CommandRequest](#commandrequest)

| --- | --- | --- |
| 202 | Successful Response | `application/json` [CommandAccepted](#commandaccepted) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### PUT /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/drive-calibration

**Set Drive Calibration**

Store the result of a drive calibration (`can_drive`, 403 when the mower is visible, else 404): the values a finished `drive_calibrate` reported in `MowerState.drive_calibration.result.calibration`. Fleet keeps them as managed options of the mower's `ble_bridge` link (the link's key stays as it is), or in the connection options of a connection kind that takes them (the simulator), and replaces a stored calibration. Audits `mower.drive_calibration_set` and publishes `mower.updated`, so the Device-Gateway hands the calibration to every spot run. Answers the stored calibration; the mower shows it as `MowerOut.drive_calibration`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [DriveCalibration](#drivecalibration)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [DriveCalibration](#drivecalibration) |
| 403 | The caller sees the mower but has no `can_drive`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower does not exist or is not visible to the caller. | no body |
| 409 | `drive-calibration-not-applicable`: the mower has no `ble_bridge` link and its connection options take no calibration. | no body |
| 422 | A value out of range. | no body |

#### DELETE /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/drive-calibration

**Delete Drive Calibration**

Forget the stored drive calibration (`can_drive`, 403 when the mower is visible, else 404); spot runs then go without one. Without a stored calibration nothing changes. Audits `mower.drive_calibration_removed` and publishes `mower.updated`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |
| 403 | The caller sees the mower but has no `can_drive`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower does not exist or is not visible to the caller. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/firmware/check

**Check Firmware**

Ask the vendor for firmware updates now (`can_view`, hidden otherwise; ADR 0038). Fleet relays the request to the Device-Gateway that holds the mower, which asks through the mower's connection and answers the fresh `FirmwareInfo` (installed and available version, release notes, update state); the same information arrives with telemetry as `MowerState.firmware_info`. Installing is the command `firmware_update` (`can_manage_mowers`).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [FirmwareInfo](#firmwareinfo) |
| 404 | The mower does not exist or is not visible to the caller. | no body |
| 409 | `firmware-check-unsupported`: the mower's connection cannot ask the vendor (no cloud link). | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |
| 503 | The mower is offline, the vendor did not answer, or no Device-Gateway answered in time. | no body |

**Get Bridge Link**

The mower's Bluetooth bridge link (`can_view`, hidden otherwise): its options with the key masked and the cached bridge information of the last scan. The live link state comes with telemetry (`MowerState.links.ble_bridge`).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [LinkOut](#linkout) |
| 404 | The mower is not visible or has no bridge link. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### PUT /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/links/ble_bridge

**Set Bridge Link**

Create or replace the mower's Bluetooth bridge link (`can_manage_mowers`, hidden otherwise): the bridge's host, port and API encryption key, the mower's Bluetooth address and name (from the scan) and the blade settings for manual driving. The options are validated with the `ble_bridge` schema of `GET /connection-kinds`; the key is stored encrypted and never returned (`***`; sending `***` keeps it). Audits `mower.link_set` and publishes `mower.updated` with the full registration, so the Device-Gateway opens the link.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [BridgeLinkIn](#bridgelinkin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [LinkOut](#linkout) |
| 403 | The caller sees the mower but has no `can_manage_mowers`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower does not exist or is not visible to the caller. | no body |
| 409 | `link-not-applicable`: the mower's connection kind carries no Bluetooth bridge link (decided by the connection-kind registry, `GET /connection-kinds`). | no body |
| 422 | An option the `ble_bridge` schema refuses (`#/links/ble_bridge/<key>`). | no body |
| 503 | Fleet has no credential encryption key. | no body |

#### DELETE /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/links/ble_bridge

**Delete Bridge Link**

Remove the mower's Bluetooth bridge link (`can_manage_mowers`, hidden otherwise). Audits `mower.link_removed` and publishes `mower.updated` without the link, so the Device-Gateway closes it.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |
| 403 | The caller sees the mower but has no `can_manage_mowers`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower is not visible or has no bridge link. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/links/ble_bridge/check

**Check Bridge Link**

Scan again through the stored link ("re-check", `can_manage_mowers`, hidden otherwise): the stored host, port and key; the reply is as for the scan and the link's `proxy_info` (bridge firmware, outdated flag) is refreshed. While the Device-Gateway holds the link open it answers from the live scanner.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [BridgeScanReply](#bridgescanreply) |
| 403 | The caller sees the mower but has no `can_manage_mowers`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower is not visible or has no bridge link. | no body |
| 409 | `link-not-applicable`: the connection kind carries no bridge link; `bridge-scan-unsupported`: the Device-Gateway cannot scan through this bridge. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |
| 503 | No Device-Gateway answered in time or holds the mower right now. | no body |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/links/ble_bridge/scan

**Scan Bridge**

Look for the mower through a Bluetooth bridge before storing the link (`can_manage_mowers`, hidden otherwise). Fleet relays the request to the Device-Gateway that holds the mower; the gateway connects to the bridge at `host`:`port` with the key, reads the bridge's information and collects mower advertisements for up to 30 s (early when the expected name shows up). The answer is the gateway's `BridgeScanReply`: `proxy` as soon as the bridge answered, `devices` seen so far, and `error` for the outcomes the user must act on (`unreachable`, `auth_failed`, `timeout`, `busy`) — these are a 200 with the reply, so a timeout still shows the bridge and the other mowers seen. When the mower already has a link to the same bridge its `proxy_info` is refreshed. `***` as key means the stored key. The key is never returned or logged.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [BridgeScanIn](#bridgescanin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [BridgeScanReply](#bridgescanreply) |
| 403 | The caller sees the mower but has no `can_manage_mowers`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower does not exist or is not visible to the caller. | no body |
| 409 | `link-not-applicable`: the connection kind carries no bridge link; `bridge-scan-unsupported`: the Device-Gateway cannot scan through this bridge. | no body |
| 422 | `***` as key without a stored link (`#/links/ble_bridge/noise_psk`). | no body |
| 503 | No Device-Gateway answered in time or holds the mower right now. | no body |

#### PUT /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/mow-defaults

**Set Mow Defaults**

Keep the mowing defaults of the mower (`can_control`; 403 when the mower is visible, else 404): the pattern settings every client starts with (web start sheet, Home Assistant, schedules). `pattern: null` drops them. Nothing is sent to the mower; a start still names its own pattern in `StartMow.pattern`. Whether the mower runs the pattern is its capabilities' business (`native_patterns`). Answers the mower with `mow_defaults`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [MowDefaultsIn](#mowdefaultsin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowerOut](#mowerout) |
| 403 | The caller sees the mower but has no `can_control`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower does not exist or is not visible to the caller. | no body |
| 422 | Unknown pattern, a value out of range or an unknown key. | no body |

#### POST /api/v1/fleet/mowers/{mower_id}/path-preview

**Preview Mow Path**

Let the mower plan the route of a start (areas and pattern as for `start_mow`) without starting it, as the vendor app does before a start: `can_control` on the mower (hidden otherwise) and the plan feature `control`. Fleet relays the request to the Device-Gateway that holds the mower; planning and fetching the route take a few seconds to about a minute (over 4G longer), so clients show progress and allow up to 90 s. The route is not stored; the start uses the same areas and pattern and the mower plans the same route again.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [PathPreviewRequest](#pathpreviewrequest)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MowPath](#mowpath) |
| 403 | The plan does not include the feature `control`. | no body |
| 404 | The mower does not exist or is not visible to the caller. | no body |
| 409 | `path-preview-unsupported`: the connection cannot plan without starting; `path-preview-rejected`: a job runs, or the areas or pattern do not fit. | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |
| 503 | The Device-Gateway did not answer or the mower is offline. | no body |
| 504 | `gateway-timeout`: the mower did not hand back its route in time. | no body |

## Schemas

### Address

Postal address of a site (all optional).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `city` | string or null | no |  |
| `country` | string or null | no | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 |
| `postal_code` | string or null | no |  |
| `street` | string or null | no |  |

### AreaNameIn

`PUT /mowers/{id}/area-names/{area_id}`: the custom name; `null` or blank drops it. Surrounding blanks are trimmed; at most 60 characters remain (422 otherwise).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string or null | yes |  |

### AreaNamesOut

The custom area names of a mower, by area id (areas without one are absent).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `names` | map of string | yes |  |

### BaseStationFirmwareUpdate

Install the firmware the vendor offers for the mower's RTK base station (`MowerState.base_station.firmware_info.available`, ADR 0047).

Sent to a mower linked to the base station: its connection asks the vendor's firmware service with the base station's id. Refused unless the base station's `update_state` is `available` and `version` equals `available`, no update of the base station is already installing, and the mower runs no job, spot run or drive session (it loses its RTK corrections while the base station restarts).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"base_station_firmware_update"` | no | default `"base_station_firmware_update"` |
| `version` | string | yes | The version to install, as offered.; min length 1; max length 64 |

### BaseStationFirmwareUpdateIn

`POST /base-stations/{id}/firmware/update`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mower_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | The linked mower that relays the request; default the first by name. |
| `version` | string | yes | The offered version (`firmware_info.available`).; min length 1; max length 64 |

### BaseStationIn

`POST /base-stations`: a device of a linked account (`source` `cloud`) or the simulator's base station (`simulated`).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `device_name` | string or null | no | `cloud`: the device (`device_type` `rtk_base` in the device list). |
| `linked_account_id` | string (uuid) or null | no | `cloud`: the linked account whose device list names it. |
| `name` | string or null | no | Defaults to the device name (`Simulated base station`). |
| `source` | `"cloud"` \| `"simulated"` | no | default `"cloud"` |

### BaseStationList

`GET /base-stations`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array of [BaseStationOut](#basestationout) | yes |  |

An RTK base station. Its live state comes with the linked mowers' telemetry (`MowerState.base_station`).

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `device_name` | string or null | yes |  |
| `id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `iot_id` | string or null | yes | The vendor's device id (unique across accounts). |
| `linked_account_id` | string (uuid) or null | yes |  |
| `model` | string or null | yes |  |
| `mower_ids` | array of string (uuid) | yes | The mowers linked to it, by name. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `source` | `"cloud"` \| `"simulated"` | yes |  |

`PATCH /base-stations/{id}`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |

### BridgeLinkIn

`PUT /mowers/{id}/links/ble_bridge`: a Bluetooth bridge (an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy) next to the mower's connection. `noise_psk` is write-only; `***` keeps the stored key.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allow_manual_blades` | boolean | no | Blades may run while the mower is driven manually.; default `false` |
| `ble_address` | string | yes | The mower's Bluetooth address (from the scan).; min length 1; max length 32 |
| `device_name` | string or null | no | The mower's Bluetooth name (from the scan); the cloud device name when omitted. |
| `host` | string | yes | Host name or IP of the bridge.; min length 1; max length 253 |
| `manual_blade_height_mm` | integer or null | no | Blade height for manual driving. |
| `manual_drive_speed_mps` | number or null | no | `max_run_speed` the mower gets when a drive session opens (ADR 0042); omitted: the mower's own speed setting for manual driving, at most 1.0 m/s. |
| `noise_psk` | string | yes | The bridge's API encryption key (`api.encryption.key` of an ESPHome bridge); `***` keeps the stored key.; min length 1; max length 256 |
| `port` | integer | no | The bridge's API port.; min 1.0; max 65535.0; default `6053` |

### BridgeScanError

The error of a :class:`BridgeScanReply`; `detail` never echoes the key.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | [BridgeScanErrorCode](#bridgescanerrorcode) | yes |  |
| `detail` | string | yes | max length 500 |
| `held_by` | string or null | no | For already_connected: the name of the mower entry whose connection holds the mower through this bridge. |

### BridgeScanErrorCode

Why a bridge scan gave no result.

Type: `"unreachable"` \| `"auth_failed"` \| `"timeout"` \| `"busy"` \| `"unsupported"` \| `"not_found"` \| `"forbidden"` \| `"already_connected"`

### BridgeScanIn

`POST /mowers/{id}/links/ble_bridge/scan`: where the bridge is and its key (`***`: the stored key of the existing link).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 253 |
| `noise_psk` | string | no | The bridge's API encryption key; `***` means the stored key.; min length 1; max length 256; default `"***"` |
| `port` | integer | no | min 1.0; max 65535.0; default `6053` |

### BridgeScanReply

Reply to :class:`BridgeScanRequest`.

`proxy` is set as soon as the proxy answered, also with a `timeout` error (the bridge works, the mower was not seen); `devices` lists every mower advertisement seen, so the client can offer a different mower than expected. `error` is null when the scan succeeded.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `devices` | array of [ScannedDevice](#scanneddevice) | no | max items 50 |
| `error` | [BridgeScanError](#bridgescanerror) or null | no |  |
| `proxy` | [ProxyInfo](#proxyinfo) or null | no |  |

### BulkCommandAccepted

Answer (202) to a command for every mower of a site or group.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bulk_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `items` | array of [BulkCommandItem](#bulkcommanditem) | no |  |
| `kind` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 64 |
| `target_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `target_type` | `"site"` \| `"group"` | yes |  |

### BulkCommandItem

One mower of a bulk command. Mowers the caller cannot see are omitted.

### DriveCalibrate

Measure what the stick values mean on the ground (ADR 0042).

MowDeck drives a few short steps with the blades off (forward at `linear` 0.3, 0.5, 0.7 and 1.0, then turns in place at `angular` ±0.3, ±0.6 and ±1.0, each `step_s` long, zero frames in between). Each step is measured over its steady window only (without the first 1.5 s, while the mower reacts), and MowDeck fits the full-scale ground speed, the full-scale yaw rate and the dead zone. Needs `MowerCapabilities.manual_drive`, an idle mower out of its dock with a fixed RTK position and about 2 m of free lawn straight ahead. Progress and the result arrive in `MowerState.drive_calibration`; `SpotStop` and `EmergencyStop` end it.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"drive_calibrate"` | no | default `"drive_calibrate"` |
| `step_s` | number | no | Duration of each step in seconds.; min 5.0; max 12.0; default `6.0` |

### DriveCalibration

The fitted drive behaviour of one mower, as stored in the drive link's options.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `calibrated_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `dead_zone` | number | no | `linear` below which the mower stands.; min 0.0; max 0.9; default `0.0` |
| `drive_speed_setting` | number or null | no | The vendor's manual-driving speed setting during the calibration (`MowerState.drive_speed_mps`); null when the connection has none. |
| `full_speed_mps` | number | yes | Ground speed at `linear = 1`.; max 5.0; greater than 0.0 |
| `full_yaw_rate_dps` | number | yes | Yaw rate at `angular = ±1` in degrees per second.; max 720.0; greater than 0.0 |
| `turn_dead_zone` | number | no | `angular` below which the mower does not turn.; min 0.0; max 0.9; default `0.0` |

### FirmwareUpdate

Install the firmware version the vendor offers (`MowerState.firmware_info.available`).

The adapter refuses it unless `update_state` is `available` and `version` equals `available` (a stale client), the mower is docked with enough battery (it need not be charging: a full mower stops charging), no job or drive session runs and no update is already installing. While it runs the mower reports the activity `updating`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"firmware_update"` | no | default `"firmware_update"` |
| `version` | string | yes | The version to install, as offered.; min length 1; max length 64 |

### MowPattern

The pattern settings of a native start (`StartMow.pattern`) that every client offers: the pattern, its base angle, the border laps and the path spacing, plus the job options a mower may declare in `MowerCapabilities.start_options` (obstacle detection, laps around no-go zones, path order, start progress; ADR 0030 amendment of 2026-10-24). An option left None is not sent, so the mower keeps its own default.

Adapters may accept further keys in `StartMow.pattern`; this is the common, validated part, also kept per mower as the mowing defaults in Fleet (`MowerOut.mow_defaults`). Whether the mower runs the pattern is decided with `MowerCapabilities.native_patterns`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `angle_deg` | number | no | Base angle of the stripes in degrees (diagonal adds 45, checkerboard crosses at 90; ignored for `edge_only` and `random_angle`).; min 0.0; max 180.0; default `0.0` |
| `border_laps` | integer | no | Laps along the area edge before the fill (`edge_only`: at least one).; min 0.0; max 4.0; default `1` |
| `name` | `"stripes"` \| `"diagonal"` \| `"checkerboard"` \| `"edge_only"` \| `"random_angle"` | no | The native pattern.; default `"stripes"` |
| `obstacle_detection` | [ObstacleDetection](#obstacledetection) or null | no | Obstacle detection mode of the job; None keeps the mower's default. Offered modes: `MowerCapabilities.start_options.obstacle_detection`. |
| `obstacle_laps` | integer or null | no | Laps around each no-go zone; None keeps the mower's default. Model limits: `MowerCapabilities.start_options.obstacle_laps_range`. |
| `order` | [PathOrder](#pathorder) or null | no | Border laps before or after the fill; None keeps the mower's default. Offered orders: `MowerCapabilities.start_options.orders`. |
| `spacing_m` | number or null | no | Distance between neighbouring paths in metres; None for the mower's own default. Model limits: `MowerCapabilities.path_spacing_range_mm`. |
| `start_progress_pct` | integer or null | no | Start the job at this progress in percent, skipping the first part of the route; None (or 0) starts at the beginning. Model limits: `MowerCapabilities.start_options.start_progress_range_pct`. |

### ObstacleDetection

How eagerly the mower avoids obstacles during a native job (`MowPattern`).

Which modes a mower offers depends on its model and firmware (`MowerCapabilities.start_options.obstacle_detection`). The names follow the vendor apps: `off` is the plain bump-and-turn behaviour, `standard` avoids obstacles it sees ahead, `sensitive` additionally avoids areas that are not lawn; `slow_touch` and `less_touch` exist only on older firmware.

Type: `"off"` \| `"slow_touch"` \| `"less_touch"` \| `"standard"` \| `"sensitive"`

### PathOrder

Whether the border laps run before or after the fill of a native job.

Type: `"border_first"` \| `"grid_first"`

### SpotMow

Mow a small spot by driving the mower along `plan` with joystick frames (ADR 0039).

Unlike `StartMow.spot_plan` the mower runs no job of its own: MowDeck's gateway steers it over the drive link (needs `MowerCapabilities.manual_drive`, a fixed RTK position and an idle mower, or a docked one when the connection can leave the dock by itself: `MowerCapabilities.undock`, ADR 0041). A transit with the blades off takes the mower from where it stands to the start of the plan; with `return_to_dock` it is sent home after the run (also after an abort that left it healthy, never after a stop). The blades stay off (a dry run) unless `blades` and `confirm_blades` are both true and the mower allows blades while driving (`manual_drive_blades`). `spot` records what the user chose; the route is `plan`. Progress arrives in `MowerState.spot_run`; `SpotStop` ends the run.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blades` | boolean | no | Cut while driving (else a dry run).; default `false` |
| `confirm_blades` | boolean | no | The user confirmed the blades separately; required with `blades`.; default `false` |
| `kind` | `"spot_mow"` | no | default `"spot_mow"` |
| `plan` | [SpotMowPlan](#spotmowplan) | yes |  |
| `return_to_dock` | boolean | no | Send the mower back to its charging station after the run (also after an abort that left it healthy; never after a stop).; default `true` |
| `speed_mps` | number | no | Driving speed of the run in metres per second (at most 0.3).; max 0.3; greater than 0.0; default `0.2` |
| `spot` | [SpotCircle](#spotcircle) or [SpotPolygon](#spotpolygon) or null | no | The spot as the user chose it (audit only). |
| `turn_style` | [TurnStyle](#turnstyle) or null | no | How the run turns at lane ends (ADR 0043); null: the mower's own setting (`MowerState.turn_style`), else `arc`. `multi_point` falls back to `arc` on a drive link without `drive_reverse`. The plan should be computed with the same style. |

| `estimated_duration_s` | number | no | min 0.0; default `0.0` |
| `native` | [SpotNativeJob](#spotnativejob) or null | no |  |
| `pattern_chain` | array of string | yes | min items 1; max items 16 |
| `plan_hash` | string | yes | SHA-256 of the chain and the segments (`spot_plan_hash`); must match.; pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `segments` | array of [SpotSegment](#spotsegment) | yes | min items 1; max items 10000 |

### SpotNativeJob

The plan expressed as a native job of the mower: whole map areas and one pattern.

Present only when the chain is exactly one pattern the mower may run by itself (`stripes`, `diagonal`, `checkerboard`, `edge_only`, or `border_fill` with one of them) on map areas, so a mower without `custom_paths` can still execute it as an ordinary `StartMow(area_ids, pattern)`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `area_ids` | array of string | yes | min items 1 |
| `pattern` | object | yes | Settings in the form of `StartMow.pattern` (`name`, `angle_deg`, `spacing_m`, `border_laps`, `order`). |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `area_ids` | array of string | no | Map area ids to mow, in order. |
| `kind` | `"start_mow"` | no | default `"start_mow"` |
| `pattern` | object or null | no | Pattern settings (validated by the pattern's own JSON Schema). |
| `plan_ref` | string or null | no | Reference to a stored mowing plan. |
| `spot_plan` | [SpotMowPlan](#spotmowplan) or null | no | A route computed by the Planner (spot mowing). Runs only on mowers with `custom_paths`, or natively when the plan carries a `native` job. |

### SyncMap

Read the mower's map again in full (areas, zones, paths, dock) and publish it. No motion; refused while a manual drive session is open (the transfer occupies the mower's command queue).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"sync_map"` | no | default `"sync_map"` |

### TimeWindow

A daily window in the mower's local time, `HH:MM` on a 24-hour clock. `end` before `start` crosses midnight (`22:00` to `06:00`).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `end` | string | yes | End, `HH:MM` (24-hour clock).; pattern `^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$` |
| `start` | string | yes | Start, `HH:MM` (24-hour clock).; pattern `^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$` |

### TurnStyle

How a spot run turns at the end of a lane (ADR 0043).

`in_place`: the mower rotates on the spot (fast, but an all-wheel-drive mower scuffs the turf). `arc`: a forward U-turn with a radius of at least half the lane spacing, or a bulb turn over the neighbouring lane when the spacing is narrower than the turning radius. `multi_point`: a three-point turn (forward arc, reverse arc with the blades off, forward arc); needs a drive link that can reverse (`MowerCapabilities.drive_reverse`).

Type: `"in_place"` \| `"arc"` \| `"multi_point"`
